using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Azure.AI.OpenAI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.AudioToText;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides an implementation of <see cref="IAudioToTextService"/> using Azure OpenAI.
    /// </summary>
    public class AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService : IAudioToTextService
    {
        private readonly AzureOpenAIClient _client;
        private readonly string _modelId;
        private readonly ILogger _logger;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="deploymentName">Azure OpenAI deployment name, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cognitive-services/openai/how-to/create-resource</param>
        /// <param name="client">Azure OpenAI client to use for the service.</param>
        /// <param name="modelId">Model identifier, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cognitive-services/openai/quickstart</param>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">Logger factory to use for the service.</param>
        public AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService(string deploymentName, AzureOpenAIClient client, string? modelId, ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
        {
            _client = client;
            _modelId = modelId ?? "whisper-base";
            _logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService>();
        }

        /// <inheritdoc/>
        public async Task<AudioToTextResult> TranscribeAsync(AudioToTextRequest request)
        {

        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.AudioToText;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides extension methods for <see cref="IServiceCollection"/> to configure Azure OpenAI connectors.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ServiceCollectionExtensions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Adds the <see cref="AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService"/> to the <see cref="IServiceCollection"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="services">The <see cref="IServiceCollection"/> instance to augment.</param>
        /// <param name="serviceId">A local identifier for the given AI service</param>
        /// <param name="factory">Factory method to create an instance of <see cref="AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService"/>.</param>
        /// <returns>The same instance as <paramref name="services"/>.</returns>
        public static IServiceCollection AddKeyedSingleton<IAudioToTextService>(this IServiceCollection services, string? serviceId, Func<IServiceProvider, object?, AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService> factory)
        {
            services.AddSingleton<IAudioToTextService>(serviceId, factory);
            return services;
        }
    }
}
